abstract: Mandatory exploring of collections of textual data should be a thing of the past, as technology matures and develops, a new learning curve for machine learning should be implemented. For that very reason, there was development of a machine learning technique called Topic Modeling, it is an unsupervised learning algorithm that helps discover hidden topics within a large collection of textual data. The framework consists of three steps; data ingestion, big data processing, topic modeling with visualization, where the topic model we discuss is based on Latent Dirichlet Allocation & Pachinko Allocation for comparison and results judgement. The aim of this project was to provide assistance and reduce burden on Market Researchers from processing data for concept discovery in a manual procedure.

canonical_title: Boom Boxing! A Voice Controlled Boxing Game
abstract: Among the fast improved game developing environment, all the game are aiming to get the player to play with from different perspective as well as method to play the game. Traditional keyboard and mouse games are becoming less popular day by day. In fact, with the fast-developing rate, games like VR, and voice control game are likely to be choose intern of game evolution. With that in mind, our group had started the BoomBoxing project in order to try ourself in this area mostly for experience. BoomBoxing is a small game that developed to allow player to move and play based on their voice only without the help of keyboard or mouse. We have applied a library in C# for Unity which is keywordrecognizer after considering a lot of other choices. All of the material for BoomBoxing will be explained as clear as our could in this report and from our website. For information inform of website and downloading the game. We suggesting u to try our website: https://phumzxter.github.io/bbstatic/index.html

canonical_title: Isekai: My Journey In The City
abstract: My Journey In the City is a diary app targeted for tourists and travellers who like to save memories while travelling. Whenever a user reaches a destination across the world, he can save that moment by saving photos and simple/short diaries. The map will show all the memories the traveller had as a pinned photo and how many diaries the traveller created during the arrival. Users can also check the places information before writing a diary from the google map. Our team has three members working on two platforms Android and iOS. We are focusing on UI/UX design, Data Modelling and API testing for most of our time during the semester. Our goal is to create an app that helps to some extent for the traveller from saving memories with ease while enjoying the journey.

abstract: In this Senior Project 2, I am building a new system for the registration of classes and theses in Master of Science in Computer Science (MSCS) curriculum, as well as the system for recording the graduation information of MSCS students. My new system will also be compared with the system that is currently used by the MSCS students, secretary, and director. As opposed to the students in BSCS, BSIT, and other bachelor's degree programs, the students in MSCS program currently use a manually approved system to register for a class or a thesis. This works fine if there are not many students, as the MSCS program typically has a maximum of 20 students in each year. However, the current system are still some pertinent drawbacks that need to be rectified. The new system provides centralized information for managing classes, theses, as well as student graduation information, to help lessen the time required when manipulating with the data. Both the current and new systems have three main user groups, consisting of the students, director, and secretary.

abstract: Real-time estimations of the presence of people in a space can help administrators better manage a space, save unnecessary costs, and provide better services. In this paper, we propose a technique to estimate the number of mobile devices in a certain place at a certain time through the Wi-Fi probe request issued by the device with a wireless network function, so as to judge whether there is a person in the place. Compared with the method using camera detection, the cost of this method is lower, and the privacy of people in the venue can be better protected. We also provide a front-end page that makes it easier for administrators to view real-time or period data reports. It also supports real-time notification of administrators when certain conditions are triggered, such as when the number of people exceeds so that corresponding measures can be carried out.
